regions.merged_text: Honestly dear Doctor, I've been thinking ever since that day, how to devise, or what, to induce something of Christian peace and harmony into that half-divorced family, - something to bring that father and whole, half-divorced family together. You can imagine my surprise this morning, therefore, when a hitherto stranger to me came begging for prayers to help "storm Heaven" for this very purpose. The party was evidently a friend of yours, as well as of your whole family. Of this I was convinced after a very few words. In- cidently, one of the primary causes lamented, with what seemed to me genuinely fraternal solicitude, brought back to me a rather disapointing remark you made on occasion of my first visit to your office. If you remember I had just given a definition of, "THE GREATEST SCIENCE OF ALL AGES" as, "RELIGION IS THE SCIENCE OF OUR HAPPY RELATION- SHIP WITH GOD AND OUR NEIGHBOR", adding that, while there may be an in- definite number of "religious systems", there can be only one science of RELIGION".
